defs.def: an activity or a piece of work that lasts a long time and requires a lot of effort and patience 马拉松式的活动（或工作）

ex.s: The night before my marathon, I dreamt that I couldn’t even find the finish line.
ex.t: 马拉松前的那天晚上，我梦见自己甚至找不到终点线。
